Philz Coffee Blend Subscription Menu Chicago Include

Philz Coffee has become a beloved name across the United States, especially for those who enjoy a more customized and curated coffee experience. The Philz coffee menu is unlike traditional cafes, offering handcrafted blends rather than standard espresso-based drinks. Whether you’re visiting a Philz location in Chicago or browsing the menu online to place an order, this guide offers a comprehensive breakdown of all offerings, including pricing tables, blend descriptions, cold brew varieties, food pairings, and subscription services.

Menu Overview

When customers browse the menu at Philz Coffee, they are greeted with a variety of handcrafted coffee blends. Instead of choosing a latte or cappuccino, customers select a unique blend that is then customized with milk, cream, sweetener, and temperature preferences. The following sections break down the offerings by category, including popular choices and how to order Philz Coffee online or in-store.

Philz Coffee Experience

Philz Coffee emphasizes a personalized brewing process. Each cup is made one at a time, and customers can specify how they like it: hot, iced, sweetened, unsweetened, creamy, or dairy-free. The focus is not just on caffeine, but on flavor balance.

Blend Options

Philz offers a wide range of blends categorized by flavor strength and profile. Blends are available in-store, through a bag subscription, or via online order.

Darker Blends

Blend Name Description Price per Bag (12 oz)
Ether Rich, bold, with dark chocolate and smoky tones $20.00
Jacob’s Wonderbar Full-bodied, syrupy with a dark, nutty essence $19.50
Julie’s Ultimate Complex, earthy with spice undertones $20.00

Medium Blends

Blend Name Description Price per Bag (12 oz)
Tesora Nutty, caramel notes with a full mouthfeel $18.50
Philtered Soul Hazelnut, cocoa, and vanilla hints $19.00
Philharmonic Balanced and smooth, hints of cardamom $18.50

Cold Brew Options

Philz offers an excellent selection of cold brew coffees which you can enjoy in-store or get via delivery. For fans of iced coffee, these are must-try options.

Cold Brew Name Description Price (16 oz)
Iced Mint Mojito Fresh mint, creamy milk, and lightly sweetened $5.50
Honey Haze Cold brew with honey and oat milk $5.75
Iced Coffee Rosé Subtle rose water flavor with a cold brew base $6.00

Order Philz Coffee

Customers can place an order through various means: visiting the website, using the app, or through delivery partners like DoorDash. To get Philz delivered to your home or office, enter your address and check if you’re within the serviceable area.

How to Place an Order

  • Browse the menu online or in the app
  • Select your desired blend, customization (milk, sweetener, etc.)
  • Choose hot or iced
  • Add any food items
  • Proceed to checkout, select delivery or pickup

Track Your Order

After placing an order online or through the app, you can track your order in real-time to know when it will arrive.

Delivery and Subscription

Philz Coffee offers a flexible subscription service, allowing customers to get their favorite blend delivered monthly. Whether you live in Chicago or another city, you can subscribe online.

Subscription Option Includes Price
Single Bag One 12 oz bag, any blend $18.00/month
Two Bags Two 12 oz bags, any blends $35.00/month
Custom Plan Choose frequency, blends, and quantity Varies

Delivery fees for individual orders may apply, but subscribers often get $0 delivery or reduced rates.

Chicago Location Info

If you’re in the Chicago area, Philz Coffee has locations in busy neighborhoods. Use the store locator on the official website to find your nearest spot and plan your visit.

Food Menu and Breakfast Options

Philz doesn’t just serve coffee. Their menu includes breakfast options that pair beautifully with their unique blends. These are also available for delivery.

Breakfast Food Items

Item Description Price
Toasted English Muffin With scrambled egg patty, cheddar, and pesto spread $4.75
Jalapeño Cheddar Biscuit Spicy and cheesy with real jalapeño pieces $3.95
Croissant Egg Sandwich Croissant dough rolled with egg and mozzarella cheese $5.50
Turkey Sausage Egg Roll Turkey sausage, egg, sundried tomato spread $5.75

Ingredients & Allergen Info

  • Wheat, soy, milk, and egg are commonly present
  • Vegan options are available (ask at the store or check online)
  • Some items contain cream cheese, feta cheese, or pepper

Popular Combinations

The following are popular combinations that many customers enjoy:

  • Iced Mint Mojito + Jalapeño Cheddar Biscuit
  • Philtered Soul + Toasted English Muffin
  • Honey Haze + Croissant Egg Sandwich

Philz Coffee App & Website

Philz Coffee’s digital experience is robust. While browsing the menu online, you may notice a message like “JavaScript is needed to run.” Ensure your browser is updated.

You can place an order, browse, and track your order directly through the app or website. It is user-friendly and lets you customize everything.

What to Expect When Visiting Philz in Chicago

When you visit a Philz Coffee shop in Chicago, you can expect:

  • A warm environment
  • Friendly baristas who make your drink from scratch
  • A food and coffee menu clearly displayed
  • Comfortable seating for work or socializing

Use Google Maps or similar services to find the closest location. To learn more about coffee brewing and blends, you can refer to this informational coffee guide by the National Coffee Association.

Bagged Coffee at Home

Philz makes it easy to enjoy their blends at home. Each bag of coffee includes:

  • Ground or whole bean
  • Roast date for freshness
  • Brew instructions

Options like Ether, Philtered Soul, and Tesora are among the top sellers for home brewing.

Customer Experience and Service

Philz Coffee is known for its unique customer service model. One barista handles your drink from start to finish. This ensures consistency and personalization. If you’re new to Philz, don’t hesitate to ask for recommendations.

What Makes Philz Special?

  • Customized brewing
  • Fresh ingredients
  • Friendly staff
  • Creative food menu

You can also check out this guide on how to enjoy coffee responsibly from Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.

Looking for more flavorful steakhouse options and seasonal favorites? Explore the full LongHorn Steakhouse menu with combo deals, food guides, and pricing.

Final Thoughts

Philz Coffee offers more than just a caffeine fix. It delivers a full experience rooted in personalization, quality, and creativity. From signature blends to food offerings and flexible subscriptions, there’s something for everyone. Whether you’re ordering online or visiting in Chicago, use this guide to browse the menu, place an order, and get the best Philz has to offer.

Explore their diverse blends, try a new item, or just enjoy a cup of iced mint mojito with your favorite breakfast bagel.

To learn more about different types of coffee blends, brewing techniques, and flavor profiles, visit this informational resource by Coffee Research Institute.
